messages:
Alex (Support): FYI escalated ticket from Veridian Health, trial activation blocked during onboarding — customers hitting 429s on embed ingestion. Marking as P0 and passing to CS for priority handling.
Maria (CS): Ack. Can you drop the ticket link + org id? I’ll start comms. :eyes:
Alex (Support): https://redwood.zendesk.com/tickets/7654321 org: veridian-health-prod
Alex (Support): key log snippet: ```2026-03-22T15:02:03Z ERROR rate_limit: exceeded 429 token_batch=1f23 org=veridian-health-prod route=/v1/embeds```
Jamal (CSM): Oof — this is an active trial with renewal signal in 2 weeks. We need a quick remediation + customer-facing comms. Recommend temporary quota bump + enablement session.
Tanvi (Success): I can own the enablement session this week. Maria, can you draft the comms? Suggest email + quick Zoom with tech lead.
Maria (CS): Drafted initial comms below, please edit: "Hi Veridian team — we’re sorry for the onboarding interruption. We’ve prioritized your job and will apply a temporary quota increase while we investigate. Can you share the sample payload that triggered the 429? — Maria"
Nick (Customer Engineer): I can repro locally if you share the payload. Also proposing a short-term routing change to Dedicated nodes for their org while we stabilize. Need approval from infra (cost delta is small).
Alex (Support): Customer already provided payload in ticket attachement (payload.json). I added it to the ticket.
Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0347 severity=P0 assigned=eng-runtime.
Jamal (CSM): ok next steps: 1) Maria sends comms within 1 hour, 2) Nick requests route bump + quota from eng-runtime, 3) Tanvi schedules enablement call for tomorrow, 4) CS to capture feedback and update renewal risk as "elevated" in Gainsight.
Maria (CS): Sending email now. Copying Tanvi & Nick. :email:
Nick (Customer Engineer): Requested routing change in eng-runtime channel — pinging @eng-runtime to approve quick Dedicated route for veridian-health-prod.
Alex (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks — payload attached. We're blocked on activation, please advise"
Tanvi (Success): Scheduling: proposed slots tomorrow 10:00 or 14:00 PT. Will include a short agenda: reproduce, config check, and onboarding checklist.
Jamal (CSM): Also flagging for renewal team: potential churn if not activated by EOD Fri. I'll open a renewal watch and attach notes from this thread.
Maria (CS): Action log: sent comms (ts 5129876580), requested payload (received), temp quota + routing requested. Will follow up after eng-runtime confirms.
Nick (Customer Engineer): Eng-runtime confirmed temporary routing and quota bump until 2026-03-29. Change id: ROUTE-842.
Alex (Support): relaying to customer now.
Tanvi (Success): Enablement invite sent for 2026-03-23 14:00 PT. Added cover items: SSO check, ingest pattern, rate-limit advice.
Jamal (CSM): Good. Please capture any qualitative feedback in the ticket and drop a short summary here after the session. We'll decide renewal outreach based on outcome.
Maria (CS): Summary template I’ll use post-call: 1) root cause hypothesis, 2) fix applied (routing/quota), 3) customer action items, 4) sentiment/next steps.
Alex (Support): Customer thanked us, said they can proceed to onboarding after call. Reaction :thumbsup:.
Jamal (CSM): Closing escalation handoff: CS owns follow-ups, Support will monitor ticket for any regressions. I’ll update renewal risk to "high" until we see successful activation.
Maria (CS): Noted — updating account health and logging this thread in the handoff playbook.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0347 updated status=mitigated assigned=eng-runtime
Maria (CS): Leaving final note here once post-call summary is ready.
